en.caution: Confirm location and operation, then ask about trotter size, char-siu extras and noodle portions. This is a map-list lead, not a taste guarantee; enter your own price.

budgetNote: 编辑规划估算，人民币／人／天；按普通双人间两人分摊住宿，包含餐饮、当地交通与门票预留。不是实时价格；独自一人、儿童、节假日和具体房型需在预算表中调整。港澳台预算以人民币规划，不代表实时汇率。
budgetNoteEn: Editorial planning allowances in CNY per person per day cover accommodation, meals, local transport and admission. The base assumes two people sharing a double room. Return travel is separate. Solo rooms, child discounts, holidays and actual room choices need adjustment. Currency conversions are indicative and do not establish local payment currencies.

广东.scope: 每城至少8个，不设上限。结合城市规模、交通与旅游需求扩充：广州20个、深圳18个、佛山与珠海各14个，5市各12个，其余12市各10个。246个条目均配参考实景；攻略深度与票价核对状态分别标示。

en.scope: At least eight attractions per city, without a cap. Editorial allocation considers city scale, transport and tourism demand: Guangzhou 20, Shenzhen 18, Foshan and Zhuhai 14 each, five cities 12 each and twelve cities 10 each. All 246 entries have reference photos; guide depth and admission verification are labeled separately.

广西.scope: 广西14市保持每城至少8个且不设上限，现有156个独立景点。本批增加11处参考实景、8家地方餐饮线索与6条分餐安排；推广资料、地图榜单与游客评价分别标明，未核实价格留空。

en.scope: All 14 Guangxi cities retain at least eight independent attractions with no cap, now 156 in total. This batch adds 11 photographed destinations, 8 regional food references and 6 meal outlines. Promotional sources, map-list leads and visitor reviews are distinguished; unconfirmed prices remain blank.

contentPolicy.countingRule: 每城至少8个是最低收录标准，不是数量上限，景点持续补充。仅统计有可追溯资料的独立景点；待调研线索不计入，同一复合景区不拆分凑数。数量达标不代表票价、开放、评价和图片全部完成核实。

ticketAudit.method: 官方景区、场馆与文旅公开票务资料；不把历史活动、政府最高限价、导览服务起价或网友报价当作现行门票。

cityExpansion.method: 编辑结合城市规模、公共交通、旅游接待与景点独立性分配；不是官方城市排名。最低8个不变，不设上限。
cityExpansion.methodEn: Editorial allocation considers city scale, transport, tourism demand and distinct attractions. It is not an official city ranking. The minimum remains eight, without a cap.

foodGuides.title: 玉州路一碗牛腩牛巴粉
foodGuides.route: 从牛腩、牛巴和牛丸中选喜欢的组合，配料加价先问。仅作一餐备选，不根据旧评的全天营业临时深夜赶去。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分餐建议，非实测步行路线。加入后新店默认不计费，选定后再勾选；空白价格不等于免费。

en.title: One Yuzhou Road beef-noodle meal
en.route: Choose brisket, niuba or meatballs and ask about extras. This is one meal option; do not rely on old all-day opening claims for a late-night visit.
en.note: Editorial meal outline, not a verified walk. New branches are excluded from costs until selected. Blank prices are unknown, not free.

foodGuides.title: 二马路粉食二选一，再选糖水
foodGuides.route: 惠钦或陈大二选一作主餐；何记另选一份糖水。三店当前价格均待填，推广起价不当整餐预算；道路与步行距离未实测。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分餐建议，非实测步行路线。加入后新店默认不计费，选定后再勾选；空白价格不等于免费。

en.title: Choose one Ermalu noodle meal, then optional sweet soup
en.route: Choose Hui Qin or Chen Da for a main meal, with one optional He Ji dessert. Current prices are unentered; promotional starting prices are not full-meal budgets. Walking distances are unverified.
en.note: Editorial meal outline, not a verified walk. New branches are excluded from costs until selected. Blank prices are unknown, not free.

foodGuides.title: 滨江共享一煲，不重复加主餐
foodGuides.route: 田螺鸭脚煲按人数选择份量，海鲜按重量和做法另问；与老城粉食分作不同餐，不默认全部都吃。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分餐建议，非实测步行路线。加入后新店默认不计费，选定后再勾选；空白价格不等于免费。

en.title: One shared riverside casserole
en.route: Choose a casserole size for your group and confirm seafood weights and cooking. Treat this as a separate meal from old-town noodles, not a compulsory extra.
en.note: Editorial meal outline, not a verified walk. New branches are excluded from costs until selected. Blank prices are unknown, not free.

foodGuides.title: 中山路烧鹅正餐备选
foodGuides.route: 椿记与已收录阿甘二选一，按人数选烧鹅或地方菜，再补主食；不把两家的人均相加当作一餐。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分餐建议，非实测步行路线。加入后新店默认不计费，选定后再勾选；空白价格不等于免费。

en.title: A Zhongshan Road roast-goose meal
en.route: Choose Chun Ji or the previously listed A Gan, then order goose or regional dishes and rice for your group. Do not add both averages as one meal.
en.note: Editorial meal outline, not a verified walk. New branches are excluded from costs until selected. Blank prices are unknown, not free.

foodGuides.title: 螺蛳鸭脚煲与一碗粉分餐
foodGuides.route: 肥螺庄作共享正餐或夜餐，西环肥仔另作一顿粉食。螺蛳煲不是单碗粉价格，同行者不吃辣时先问菜单。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分餐建议，非实测步行路线。加入后新店默认不计费，选定后再勾选；空白价格不等于免费。

en.title: Separate snail casserole and noodle meals
en.route: Use Feiluo Zhuang for a shared meal and Xihuan Feizai for another noodle meal. A casserole is not priced like one bowl; ask about mild options.
en.note: Editorial meal outline, not a verified walk. New branches are excluded from costs until selected. Blank prices are unknown, not free.

foodGuides.title: 东兴教育路鸡粉与越式炒螺
foodGuides.route: 鸡粉作简餐，炒螺或春卷作另一餐或按食量加餐；两店分别核对营业和海鲜价格，不保证固定步行时长。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分餐建议，非实测步行路线。加入后新店默认不计费，选定后再勾选；空白价格不等于免费。

en.title: Dongxing Jiaoyu Road noodles and Vietnamese-style snails
en.route: Use chicken noodles for a light meal and snails or spring rolls for another meal or a modest extra. Confirm each shop’s hours and seafood prices; walking time is unverified.
en.note: Editorial meal outline, not a verified walk. New branches are excluded from costs until selected. Blank prices are unknown, not free.

foodGuides.title: 水街粉饺与糯米饭分餐尝
foodGuides.route: 老甘粉饺与老嘢糯米饭分作不同餐，二选一也可；不把两份主食默认为同一餐。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Separate Shuijie dumpling and sticky-rice meals
en.route: Use Lao Gan and Lao Ye for different meals, or choose one. Two main dishes are not automatically one meal.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 建政路卷筒粉与桂菜备选
foodGuides.route: 古记作夜间小吃；阿谋或甘家界二选一另安排正餐。古城路与仙葫大道分区，不当步行串店路线。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Jianzheng rice rolls and alternative Guangxi meals
en.route: Consider Gu Ji for an evening snack; choose A Mou or Ganjiajie for another meal. Gucheng Road and Xianhu Avenue are separate areas, not a walking crawl.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 汤螺蛳粉与干捞粉轮换
foodGuides.route: 西环肥仔、螺小丰、大华分餐轮换，每餐选一家；多人想吃菜再选望江寨，市区不同片区交通另查。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Alternate soup luosifen and dry rice noodles
en.route: Choose one noodle shop per meal, alternating styles. Wangjiangzhai is an optional shared meal. Check transport between city areas.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 市区油茶与阳朔米粉分日
foodGuides.route: 蜂子在桂林市区尝油茶；勝记配阳朔西街另一天，不为一碗粉当天往返两地。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Separate Guilin oil tea and Yangshuo noodles
en.route: Try Fengzi oil tea in Guilin, then Sheng Ji during a separate Yangshuo day. Do not make a same-day intercity return just for noodles.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 潘塘豆浆与纸包鸡分餐
foodGuides.route: 潘塘店作豆浆点心一餐；想吃纸包鸡可另选已收录大东大酒家作正餐。两种预算分别勾选，避免同餐重复。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Pantang soy breakfast and paper-wrapped chicken
en.route: Use Pantang for a soy-milk and snack meal. The previously listed Big East Restaurant is a separate paper-wrapped-chicken option; select meals separately.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 侨港正餐之后选一份炒冰
foodGuides.route: 正餐从已收录的侨港门店中选一家；有间冰室选炒冰或清补凉之一作加餐，不默认再吃一顿海鲜。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: One Qiaogang dessert after a meal
en.route: Choose one of the listed Qiaogang restaurants for a meal. Add one stir-frozen ice or sweet soup at You Jian, not a second seafood meal.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 黄姚酿菜与八步凉粉分区
foodGuides.route: 供销社配黄姚游览吃豆腐酿、豆豉菜；马峰在八步市区另作甜品，不把两地写成步行路线。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Separate Huangyao stuffed dishes and Babu jelly
en.route: Pair Gongxiaoshe’s stuffed tofu and black-bean dishes with Huangyao. Mafeng is a separate dessert in Babu city, not a walk between the two.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 右江城区烧鸭粉与壮菜
foodGuides.route: 烧鸭粉作一顿简餐，壮家人作另一顿多人正餐；按住宿位置确认城区接驳。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Roast-duck noodles and Zhuang dishes in Youjiang
en.route: Use roast-duck noodles for a light meal and Zhuangjiaren for a separate shared meal. Check city transport from your accommodation.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 靖西市区与通灵方向分餐
foodGuides.route: 五色糯米饭可在靖西市区尝；大盘菜配通灵峡谷方向。两店相隔县域路程，不为吃饭硬折返。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Separate Jingxi town and Tongling-area meals
en.route: Try five-colour sticky rice in Jingxi town, and Dapancai on a Tongling Gorge outing. Do not backtrack across the county solely for a meal.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 宜州豆腐正餐与夜餐二选
foodGuides.route: 耕饭山庄尝手工豆腐等；老猫可选鸭掌煲作另一餐，两家同餐二选一，不承诺短距离步行。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Yizhou tofu meal and an alternative evening meal
en.route: Consider handmade tofu at Gengfan and duck-foot casserole at Laomao for different meals, or choose one. A short walk between them is not confirmed.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 来宾米饺与金秀瑶乡菜分日
foodGuides.route: 芳姐米饺在来宾城区；山里人在金秀县城，配金秀住宿或山地游览单独安排，避免跨县赶一餐。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Separate Laibin rice dumplings and Jinxiu cooking
en.route: Fang Jie is in Laibin city; Shanliren is in Jinxiu town. Pair Jinxiu dining with a stay or mountain visit, not a cross-county meal rush.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 大新粉食与硕龙土菜分段
foodGuides.route: 大新县城选卷筒粉或少量烧烤；老街土菜馆配硕龙、德天方向另排正餐，不一次勾选成三餐套餐。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: Daxin noodles and Shuolong regional cooking
en.route: Choose rice rolls or a small barbecue meal in Daxin town. Pair Lao Jie with Shuolong or Detian separately; these are not one compulsory three-meal package.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 凭祥越式一餐
foodGuides.route: 鸡肉粉可作简餐，春卷与酸汤适合多人分食；同店可调整用餐次数，不自动把每道菜当一份人均。
foodGuides.note: 当地特色编辑安排；非实测步行路线。加入消费后新店默认关闭，逐店勾选，备选店不重复计费。

en.title: One Vietnamese-style meal in Pingxiang
en.route: Chicken noodles suit a light meal; share spring rolls and sour soup. Adjust visits for this branch; each dish is not another per-person meal.
en.note: Editorial local-food outline, not a verified walk. New route branches are excluded from costs until selected; alternatives are not charged together.

foodGuides.title: 西关的一餐与一碗糖水
foodGuides.route: 坚记 / 吴财记二选一 → 开记甜品；想坐下来吃粤菜，可换成广州酒家。
foodGuides.note: 文明路达扬与海珠南园是不同片区，另排半天，不把七家店塞进一餐。

en.title: A meal and dessert in Xiguan
en.route: Choose Jian Ji or Wu Cai Ji, then Kai Ji dessert. For a seated Cantonese meal, substitute Guangzhou Restaurant.
en.note: Dayang on Wenming Road and Nan Yuan in Haizhu are in different areas. Do not pack seven restaurants into one meal.

foodGuides.title: 华强北：早茶或一顿快餐
foodGuides.route: 凤凰楼 / 蘩楼二选一；赶行程时可将大家乐作为快餐备选。
foodGuides.note: 水围的台山佬黄鳝饭另排交通；茶位、服务费和份量先问清。

en.title: Huaqiangbei: dim sum or a quick meal
en.route: Choose Phoenix House or Fan Lou for dim sum; Cafe de Coral is a quicker alternative.
en.note: Taishan Lao in Shuiwei requires separate transport. Ask about tea/service charges and portion sizes.

foodGuides.title: 大良甜品与陈村粉分开吃
foodGuides.route: 清晖园后可在华盖路民信、仁信各点一小份分享；正餐留给下一餐。
foodGuides.note: 黄但记、黄均记在陈村，与大良不属同一段步行线路。

en.title: Daliang desserts and Chencun noodles
en.route: After Qinghui Garden, share a small dessert at Min Xin or Ren Xin on Huagai Road. Leave room for a proper meal.
en.note: Huang Dan Ji and Huang Jun Ji are in Chencun, not on the same walking route as Daliang.

foodGuides.title: 古城小吃，牛肉火锅二选一
foodGuides.route: 胡荣泉买小份小吃；晚餐在古城阿彬与官塘兄弟之间按位置选择。
foodGuides.note: 官塘在古城外；同名分店要核对，套餐与单点不能直接比人均。

en.title: Old-town snacks and one beef-hotpot meal
en.route: Try small snacks at Hu Rong Quan, then choose A Bin or Guantang Brothers by location.
en.note: Guantang lies outside the old town. Verify the branch and compare portions as well as set-menu prices.

foodGuides.title: 小公园粿点与牛肉火锅
foodGuides.route: 国平路飘香可尝粿点拼盘，另一餐再考虑杏花吴记牛肉火锅。
foodGuides.note: 两处不是同一景点内部；火锅候位可能较长，预留弹性时间。

en.title: Little Park snacks and beef hotpot
en.route: Try a shared dumpling plate at Piaoxiang on Guoping Road, with Xinghua Wu Ji as a separate meal.
en.note: These are separate stops. Hotpot queues can be long, so keep the schedule flexible.

foodGuides.title: 先分市区与横琴，再选海鲜
foodGuides.route: 富华里豪蚝记适合市区行程；横琴人家、创新方蚝大仙按横琴路线选。
foodGuides.note: 先看时价、重量、锅底和加工费，平台人均不是固定套餐。

en.title: Choose city-center or Hengqin seafood first
en.route: Hao Hao Ji in Fuhuali fits a city-center day; Hengqin Renjia and Novotown’s Hao Daxian fit Hengqin.
en.note: Check market price, weight, broth and preparation charges. A platform average is not a fixed set meal.

foodGuides.title: 侨乡美食，按台山与恩平选店
foodGuides.route: 台山线路可选兴华黄鳝饭；恩平线路可选鸿兴黄鳝饭。
foodGuides.note: 这两家均不在蓬江老城步行范围内；不为同类菜品来回跨县。

en.title: Match emigrant-town food with Taishan or Enping
en.route: Choose Xing Hua for a Taishan day or Hong Xing for an Enping day.
en.note: Neither is within walking distance of Pengjiang’s old town. Avoid cross-county detours for similar dishes.

foodGuides.title: 宝华路小份午餐
foodGuides.route: 宝华面店主食 → 陈添记小份鱼皮（可省）→ 顺记一份雪糕分食
foodGuides.note: 面店、鱼皮店含不同过敏原；食量小直接面加雪糕即可。

en.title: Baohua Road light lunch
en.route: Noodles → optional small fish-skin dish → shared ice cream
en.note: For a small appetite, noodles plus ice cream are enough.

foodGuides.title: 文明路炖汤与糖水
foodGuides.route: 达扬炖品 → 百花或玫瑰二选一
foodGuides.note: 炖汤不等于完整正餐；甜品两家不必都吃，按座位与队长选择。

en.title: Wenming Road soup & dessert
en.route: Dayang soup → Bai Hua OR Rose dessert
en.note: Soup alone is not a complete meal; choose one dessert shop by the queue.

foodGuides.title: 上下九早茶与甜品
foodGuides.route: 陶陶居早午茶 → 逛上下九 → 南信小份甜品
foodGuides.note: 茶点是一顿正餐；先核对茶位，南信可改外带或省略。

en.title: Shangxiajiu dim sum & dessert
en.route: Tao Tao Ju brunch → Shangxiajiu walk → small Nan Xin dessert
en.note: Dim sum is a full meal; check tea charges and skip dessert if full.

foodGuides.title: 天河商圈一餐方案
foodGuides.route: 正佳广场内安排一顿陶陶居；不为同品牌跨城取店
foodGuides.note: 适合购物或雨天；仅一餐方案，不是多店步行打卡线。

en.title: Tianhe shopping-district meal
en.route: One Tao Tao Ju meal inside Grandview Plaza
en.note: Useful on a shopping or rainy day; a single-meal option.

foodGuides.title: 泮塘早餐与龙津晚餐
foodGuides.route: 早餐凌记濑粉 → 白天游览 → 晚餐向群合菜
foodGuides.note: 分两个时段，泮塘至龙津东路需另查交通，不是连续小吃线。

en.title: Pantang breakfast & Longjin dinner
en.route: Ling Ji breakfast → sightseeing → Xiang Qun dinner
en.note: Two separate meal times; check transport from Pantang to Longjin East.

foodGuides.title: 东门早茶二选一
foodGuides.route: 唐宫或新福楼任选一家 → 东门街区游览
foodGuides.note: 新福楼公开样本较少；两家都需确认茶位与时段，勿连吃两顿早茶。

en.title: Dongmen dim-sum alternatives
en.route: Tang Palace OR Xin Fu Lou → explore Dongmen
en.note: Xin Fu Lou has fewer public reviews; check tea charges and choose one.

foodGuides.title: 东门砂锅粥晚餐
foodGuides.route: 东门游览后 → 中兴路金稻园砂锅粥
foodGuides.note: 粥锅先问适合几人，预留现煮时间；不沿用旧乐园路地址。

en.title: Dongmen congee dinner
en.route: After Dongmen sightseeing → Jin Dao Yuan on Zhongxing Road
en.note: Ask how many people a pot serves; allow cooking time. Use the current Zhongxing address.

foodGuides.title: 蛇口早茶半日
foodGuides.route: 华洋早茶 → 蛇口片区游览
foodGuides.note: 早茶后留半日游览；与华强北和光明分开排，停车情况需核对。

en.title: Shekou dim-sum half day
en.route: Hua Yang dim sum → explore Shekou
en.note: Allow half a day in Shekou; plan separately from Huaqiangbei and Guangming.

foodGuides.title: 盐田海山海滨晚餐
foodGuides.route: 海山片区游览 → 壹海城金稻园晚餐
foodGuides.note: 只对应盐田分店，天气、海滨步道开放和回程交通另查。

en.title: Haishan waterfront dinner
en.route: Explore Haishan → Jin Dao Yuan at One Mall
en.note: This is the Yantian branch; check weather, promenade access and return transport.

foodGuides.title: 八卦岭晚间烧烤
foodGuides.route: 八卦岭木屋少量点串 → 按食量加单
foodGuides.note: 不承诺夜间营业时段；历史评论提醒价格与份量，先看菜单。

en.title: Bagualing evening barbecue
en.route: Start with a few skewers at Mu Wu; add gradually
en.note: Check current evening hours; historical reviews raise price and portion concerns.

foodGuides.title: 大良早茶与华盖小吃
foodGuides.route: 龙的早茶 → 清晖园片区游览 → 细妹或民信/仁信小份加餐
foodGuides.note: 早茶店至华盖路另查交通；牛杂和两家奶店不必全部吃。

en.title: Daliang dim sum & Huagai snacks
en.route: Long De dim sum → sightseeing near Qinghui Garden → one small snack
en.note: Check transport to Huagai Road; do not try every snack shop in one meal.

foodGuides.title: 容桂一顿顺德菜
foodGuides.route: 松记清水火锅 或 猪肉婆顺德菜 → 容桂片区游览
foodGuides.note: 选一家作为正餐；两家并非相邻步行点，先查询交通及排号。

en.title: Ronggui main-meal alternatives
en.route: Song Ji hotpot OR Zhu Rou Po Shunde dishes → explore Ronggui
en.note: Choose one main meal; these are not adjacent stops. Check transport and queues.

foodGuides.title: 禅城饺子与家常菜
foodGuides.route: 早餐/午餐北香园 → 禅城游览 → 晚餐有记（可选）
foodGuides.note: 分两顿安排，金鱼街与锦华路需导航确认；不与顺德路线混排。

en.title: Chancheng dumplings & home-style dishes
en.route: Bei Xiang Yuan brunch → Chancheng sightseeing → optional You Ji dinner
en.note: Separate meals; check navigation between the streets and avoid mixing in Shunde towns.

foodGuides.title: 伦教糕点停靠
foodGuides.route: 伦教总店买小份伦教糕 → 伦教片区活动
foodGuides.note: 不是大良步行路线；不建议仅为一份糕点远途折返。

en.title: Lunjiao rice-cake stop
en.route: Small takeaway rice cake → activities around Lunjiao
en.note: Not a Daliang walking route; avoid a long return trip solely for a cake.

foodGuides.title: 小公园干面与粽球
foodGuides.route: 爱西一份面汤 → 老妈宫小份分食（可省）→ 小公园游览
foodGuides.note: 粽球较顶饱；飘香可替换粽球，不建议把三家都当正餐。

en.title: Xiaogongyuan noodles & rice dumplings
en.route: Ai Xi noodles and soup → optional shared rice dumpling → Xiaogongyuan
en.note: Rice dumplings are filling; Piaoxiang is an alternative, not another full meal.

foodGuides.title: 人民广场豆花停靠
foodGuides.route: 人民广场片区游览 → 张钦德小份豆花
foodGuides.note: 作为加餐而非正餐；不把豆花店与长平路火锅当近邻。

en.title: People’s Square tofu-dessert stop
en.route: Explore People’s Square → a small Zhang Qin De tofu dessert
en.note: A snack, not a main meal; do not assume it is next to Changping hotpot.

foodGuides.title: 金新早餐与长平晚餐
foodGuides.route: 早餐金新肠粉 → 白天游览 → 晚餐福合埕（长平国新）
foodGuides.note: 跨片区分早晚安排，火锅与杏花吴记二选一；交通另查。

en.title: Jinxin breakfast & Changping dinner
en.route: Jin Xin breakfast → sightseeing → Fu He Cheng dinner
en.note: Separate areas and meal times; choose this hotpot or Xinghua Wu Ji and check transport.

foodGuides.title: 开元路素食与粿点
foodGuides.route: 开元咸水粿小份 → 古城游览 → 莲华素食正餐
foodGuides.note: 胡荣泉甜品可替换咸水粿；素食店蛋奶、葱蒜与过敏原须确认。

en.title: Kaiyuan vegetarian meal & rice cakes
en.route: Small savory rice cakes → old-town sightseeing → Lian Hua vegetarian meal
en.note: Hu Rong Quan dessert can replace the rice cakes; confirm egg, dairy, alliums and allergens.

foodGuides.title: 拱北早茶或茶餐厅
foodGuides.route: 益健早茶 或 颓记一顿简餐 → 拱北片区游览
foodGuides.note: 两家二选一，北岭与水湾路需查交通；不连排横琴蚝餐。

en.title: Gongbei dim sum or cafe
en.route: Yi Jian dim sum OR a Tui Ji cafe meal → explore Gongbei
en.note: Choose one; check transport between Beiling and Shuiwan Road. Plan Hengqin separately.

foodGuides.title: 老香洲家常晚餐
foodGuides.route: 老香洲活动后 → 湛星白切鸡配捞河粉
foodGuides.note: 海鲜可省；若点海鲜，先确认单价、称重和加工费。

en.title: Old Xiangzhou dinner
en.route: After old Xiangzhou sightseeing → chicken and rice noodles at Zhan Xing
en.note: Seafood is optional; confirm unit price, weight and preparation fees before ordering.

foodGuides.title: 莞城糖水加餐
foodGuides.route: 莞城活动后 → 棉记一碗糖水或一份咸面
foodGuides.note: 不是石龙或大岭山烧鹅的步行延伸线；以瑞龙路门牌导航。

en.title: Guancheng dessert break
en.route: After Guancheng sightseeing → dessert or noodles at Mian Ji
en.note: Not a walking extension of Shilong or Dalingshan; navigate using the Ruilong address.

foodGuides.title: 沙溪隆都菜一餐
foodGuides.route: 沙溪片区活动 → 荔苑隆都菜馆分食一餐
foodGuides.note: 与石岐张溪店铺分开安排；少人先问小份，不必点整鸡。

en.title: Shaxi Longdu-style meal
en.route: Activities around Shaxi → shared Longdu-style meal at Li Yuan
en.note: Plan separately from Shiqi; smaller groups should ask about half portions.

foodGuides.title: 老城粉食与家常菜
foodGuides.route: 舒记与中山粉饺可分作两顿；米马河另作正餐，勿把小吃重复计入同一餐。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Old-city noodles and local cooking
en.route: Split Shu Ji and Zhongshan rice dumplings across meals; use Mimahe as a separate main meal.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 青秀山与万象片区分区用餐
foodGuides.route: 青秀山游览后可选乌布；万象城桂小厨与高层酒店餐厅分属不同用餐选择，不要求全部打卡。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Separate Qingxiu and MixC meals
en.route: Consider Ubud after Qingxiu Mountain. Gui Xiao Chu and hotel restaurants are alternatives, not compulsory stops.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 市区米粉与桂菜
foodGuides.route: 崇善米粉作早餐；阿甘或漓江观景餐厅二选一作正餐，咖啡餐厅另选，不把观景溢价当本地日常价。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: City rice noodles and Guilin cooking
en.route: Choose Chongshan for breakfast; choose A Gan or a river-view restaurant for a main meal. The cafe is optional; view premiums are not everyday local prices.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 阳朔西街与遇龙河分日安排
foodGuides.route: 西街大师傅与谢大姐二选一吃啤酒鱼；生态苑与遇龙河游览搭配，另排一天，核对按斤计价。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Separate West Street and Yulong River days
en.route: Choose either West Street beer-fish restaurant. Pair Shengtaiyuan with a separate Yulong River day; check fish pricing units.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 市中心一碗粉与一顿正餐
foodGuides.route: 六品坊作一顿螺蛳粉；米诗莱为另一顿西式餐选择。不要默认两店都算同一餐。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Central noodles and a separate meal
en.route: Use Liupinfang for a noodle meal; Maislin is a separate Western-style option, not another mandatory stop in the same meal.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 侨港包点与海鲜
foodGuides.route: 梁记可作早餐或点心；好食来、越乡与鲨渔港三选一正餐，海鲜先问价，侨港与老街分区。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Qiaogang buns and seafood
en.route: Liang Ji suits breakfast or a snack. Choose one of the three seafood restaurants; agree prices first. Plan the old street separately.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 纸包鸡与粤式茶点
foodGuides.route: 大东作纸包鸡等正餐参考，国龙作茶点或另一顿饭；两个区域交通另查。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Paper-wrapped chicken and dim sum
en.route: Consider Big East for paper-wrapped chicken and Guolong for dim sum or another meal. Check transport between areas.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodGuides.title: 东兴粉食与企沙海鲜分开安排
foodGuides.route: 东兴华姐鸡粉与企沙富哥分属不同片区，分别配合东兴和渔港行程；御鑫记为城市正餐备选。
foodGuides.note: 编辑分区建议，不是已核验步行路线；加入餐饮清单后逐店勾选，备选店不自动一起计费。

en.title: Separate Dongxing noodles and Qisha seafood
en.route: Pair Hua Jie with Dongxing and Fu Ge with Qisha on separate outings. Yuxinji is an alternative urban meal.
en.note: Editorial area outline, not a verified walking route. Add to the dining list and select individual branches; alternatives are not automatically charged together.

foodCoverage.method: 携程、去哪儿、大众点评公开条目，结合B站公开视频简介、餐厅官方与经营方资料。视频未完整观看；不把商家或平台推荐当作真实到访证明。
foodCoverage.methodEn: Public Ctrip, Qunar and Dianping listings, Bilibili video descriptions and restaurant/operator sources. Videos were not watched in full. Platform recommendations are not proof of a visit.

foodDepth.method: 按城市规模、旅游热度及餐饮目的地特色分配编辑检索量，广州、深圳、佛山、汕头优先加密；不是官方热度排名。先看具体分店、评价量、内容一致性和争议，再决定收录，不按数量硬凑。平台分数不能证明评价真实或保证营业、品质。 广西首轮优先南宁、桂林、北海等城市，按具体分店首批筛选平台评分至少4.3/5且至少20条评价的门店；这只是候选筛选条件，不能证明真实到访。暂无合适样本的城市继续调研，不为覆盖率凑店。 广西后续优先地方菜、小吃和具体分店；公开评分优先较好且有可读样本的门店，少于20条另标小样本，不把平台转评当独立证据。
foodDepth.methodEn: Editorial research prioritizes city scale, tourism demand and culinary interest, with greater depth in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Foshan and Shantou. This is not an official ranking. Branch identity, review volume, consistency and concerns are considered before inclusion; platform scores cannot prove authenticity or guarantee opening or quality. Initial Guangxi research prioritizes Nanning, Guilin and Beihai, selecting specific branches with platform scores of at least 4.3/5 and at least 20 reviews. These are screening thresholds, not proof of actual visits. Cities without suitable samples remain under research. Subsequent Guangxi research prioritizes regional dishes, snacks and specific branches. Better public scores and readable samples are preferred; fewer than 20 reviews are labeled small-sample, and syndicated reviews are not independent evidence.

广西.method: 广西按城市交通集散能力、旅游需求与目的地分布作编辑分配：桂林山水及县域目的地较密集，南宁为区内交通枢纽，柳州和北海兼顾城市与周边旅游。不是官方排名或实时热度指数，其他城市同样保持至少8个独立景点。
广西.methodEn: Editorial allocation considers transport hubs, tourism demand and destination distribution. Guilin has extensive city and county attractions; Nanning is a regional transport hub, while Liuzhou and Beihai combine urban and surrounding tourism. This is not an official ranking or live popularity index. Other cities retain at least eight independent attractions.
